title: Vesper and the Oath
author: Sable Eastwick
blurb: Ines Montrose, a bone-carver who hears the dead, has spent ten years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. Then a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must find the door out of a country that no longer exists, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
